title: Implement RMSNorm
hint: RMS(x) = sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps). RMSNorm(x) = x / RMS(x) * weight. Simpler than LayerNorm â€” no mean subtraction.

description.text: Implement RMSNorm: scale the input by the RMS (root-mean-square) over the last dimension, then multiply by a learnable weight. No mean centering (unlike LayerNorm).

examples.input: x shape (B, T, D); weight shape (D,)
examples.output: x / RMS(x) * weight per last-dim slice; same shape as x.

constraints: weight broadcasts like the last dim of x.
Do not use nn.LayerNorm, nn.RMSNorm, or F.normalize shortcuts for the full op.
